raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`, each prefill pass still makes the host wait on the GPU 3–4 times while preparing attention metadata for the late-layer tail. #41659 removed the other prefill host syncs, and this PR removes the remaining ones.

## Modifications

- In `late_layer_tail_layout` and `_build_late_layer_tail_metadata`, copy the tail length lists to the GPU with `async_h2d` (added in #41659) instead of `torch.tensor(..., device=...)`, which blocks.
- In `_build_late_layer_tail_metadata`, pass `output_size=sum(tail_lens_cpu)` to the `repeat_interleave` that builds `low_ratio_req_indices`, so it no longer reads the total length back from the GPU.

Values are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K (`python -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions 1319 --parallel 16`), two server starts per arm, server flags below.

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Accuracy | 0.907, 0.909 | 0.909, 0.909 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Main `f47d895` vs. this commit on top, TP4 on B200, flags below. Restarting the server shifted latency more than this change does, so both versions ran in one server, alternating between blocks of requests.

**Host syncs per prefill pass** (`torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode`, every rank):

| | 1 × 16K | 4 × 4K |
|---|---|---|
| main | 3 | 4 |
| this PR | 0 | 0 |

**Prefill latency.** N cold requests with random token ids sent together; latency = time until the last first token, median over 40-80 waves per path.

| Batch × input | main (ms) | this PR (ms) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 × 1K | 147 | 147 | +0.1% |
| 1 × 2K | 147 | 147 | -0.2% |
| 1 × 4K | 145 | 145 | -0.4% |
| 1 × 8K | 146 | 145 | -0.8% |
| 1 × 16K | 182 | 183 | +0.1% |
| 4 × 16K | 771 | 771 | -0.1% |
| 16 × 1K | 356 | 356 | +0.1% |
| 16 × 4K | 956 | 952 | -0.4% |
| 16 × 8K | 1614 | 1604 | -0.6% |
| 16 × 16K | 3150 | 3143 | -0.2% |

For 4 × 1K-8K and 16 × 2K, whether the requests share one prefill pass or are split over two depends on when they arrive, and that dominates the latency; within each case both paths match within 1%.

**Serving** (`bench_serving` `generated-shared-prefix`: 8 groups × 16 prompts, 80K shared prefix + 8K new tokens, 256 output tokens, concurrency 32), median of 15 runs per path:

| Metric | main | this PR | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Median TTFT (ms) | 1285 | 1277 | -0.6% |
| P99 TTFT (ms) | 12130 | 12193 | +0.5% |
| Median E2E latency (ms) | 4243 | 4214 | -0.7% |
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 1292 | 1294 | +0.2% |

The remaining prefill syncs go to zero, and prefill and serving latency stay within 1% of main.

<details>
<summary>Server flags</summary>

```
PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE=1 \
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --trust-remote-code \
  --tp 4 --ep-size 4 --mem-fraction-static 0.70 --enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 2 \
  --swa-prefix-tails 256 --context-length 1048576 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --max-prefill-tokens 16384 \
  --prefill-decode-interval 4 --max-running-requests 32 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled \
  --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 --enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek-v41 --tool-call-parser deepseekv41 --tokenizer-backend fastokens \
  --enable-flashinfer-allreduce-fusion --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report
```

</details>

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body:
The tail metadata changes still look useful as a small follow-up. #41659 has merged now; could you rebase and drop the overlapping indexer/Engram changes? Please measure the remaining syncs and TTFT against updated main, since the current numbers include those overlapping changes.

I'd keep the mHC `record_stream` removal separate so we can check the input lifetime through the stream joins and graph capture/replay.

Sorry for the delay! Wanted to dig more into separating `record_stream` because keeping it caused performance issues without syncs, but after [https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42245](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42245) prefill no longer uses it anyways so this isn't a concern.

I've rebased onto main and re-ran benchmarks. There are no more prefill host syncs, although latency is basically unchanged, I think probably because the late-layer metadata syncs are before any of the model layers run.

I'm fairly sure this is already on main - #45275 ("Drop host syncs from encoder-replay folding and tail metadata") removed the remaining tail-metadata host syncs, and the overlapping indexer part already merged as #41659. Closing as superseded; please reopen if I've missed a case.
